QuestInfo.name: Moonlight Text
QuestInfo.0: What could the Book of Ancient be about? Something ancient, maybe? Whatever it is, it needs to stay away from the Black Mage... Maybe Shinsoo might know more.
QuestInfo.1: Ask Shinsoo about the contents of the book.
QuestInfo.2: You have learned about the Transcendents from Shinsoo. Among the three Transcendents, what could have happened to the World Tree?
